modules.title: Introduction to The Prophets: Amos and Hosea
modules.html:
Amos preaches social justice and righteousness; Hosea uses his marriage to picture God's love and Israel's unfaithfulness. This section covers introduction to the prophets: amos and hosea.

Key points

  • The prophet who challenged the 450 prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel was _____. — Elijah.
  • Amos emphasized that true worship must be accompanied by _____. — justice and righteousness.
  • The message of Prophet Hosea focused primarily on the _____ of God. — unconditional love.
  • The theme of the book of Amos is God's _____. — justice.
  • Elijah's contest with the prophets of Baal took place on Mount _____. — Carmel.

Worked examples

Q: The prophet who challenged the 450 prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel was _____.
A: Elijah — Elijah sought to prove that Yahweh is the only true God by calling down fire on the altar.

Q: Amos emphasized that true worship must be accompanied by _____.
A: justice and righteousness — Amos 5:24 says, 'But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream'.

quiz.q: The prophet who challenged the 450 prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel was _____.
quiz.solution: Elijah sought to prove that Yahweh is the only true God by calling down fire on the altar.

quiz.q: Amos emphasized that true worship must be accompanied by _____.
quiz.solution: Amos 5:24 says, 'But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream'.

quiz.q: The message of Prophet Hosea focused primarily on the _____ of God.
quiz.solution: Hosea's marriage to Gomer served as a metaphor for God's steadfast love for unfaithful Israel.

quiz.q: The theme of the book of Amos is God's _____.
quiz.solution: Amos was a prophet of social justice who condemned the oppression of the poor by the wealthy in Israel.

quiz.q: Elijah's contest with the prophets of Baal took place on Mount _____.
quiz.solution: Mount Carmel was the site where Elijah proved that Yahweh is God by calling down fire to consume the sacrifice.

quiz.q: Hosea’s marriage to _____ was a symbolic representation of God’s relationship with unfaithful Israel.
quiz.solution: God commanded Hosea to marry an unfaithful woman (Gomer) to illustrate Israel's spiritual adultery through idol worship.
